project.name: @tameion/home
project.productType: the account an agent operator gives its agents: a landing that becomes the book, an Owner view and an Agent view behind one toggle

design.concept: The strait becomes the book. A Sentinel-2 photograph of the Strait of Hormuz is quantised to a grid, drained of colour, its vessels tracked from a recorded AIS window, and the labels become the rows of a real account. The pixel grid is the ledger grid.
design.colorMode: light-default (Owner, paper); dark is the Agent view (sea), not an inversion

typography.interface: IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600, tabular lining figures
typography.machine: IBM Plex Mono 400/500 (hero tracking labels, the whole Agent view)

motion.hero: one scroll-bound sequence: photograph -> grid -> drain -> tracking -> hand-over -> the book
motion.reducedMotion: three stills for the hero; instant swaps elsewhere

design.density: low in the Owner view, high in the Agent view

shortlist: segmented control -> the Owner | Agent capsule
order / receipt card -> the authority receipt (Tameion can / can never / Worst case)
patterns: a pick keeps its structure and loses its colours, radii and shadows to tokens
one file per pick with its source line: component, author, URL, why

must: resolve every colour to a token; no hex outside the tokens file
no hash anywhere in the Owner view (test: /0x[0-9a-fA-F]{8,}/ fails the build)
one primary action per screen; the attention red never carries anything but Needs you, Stop, refused, failures
tabular lining figures wherever money or time appears
monospace only for the machine's eye: hero tracking labels and the Agent view
every state designed: loading skeleton >= 300ms, empty with a next action, error with what still works, offline marked stale with its time
a disabled primary button names the first fixable reason and does it
the hero uses only recorded material: a dated Sentinel-2 scene, a stated aisstream window with real MMSIs, the demo account's real records
reduced motion: stills and instant swaps; axe-core clean in both views
the judges' live path (the account page) loads with no hero and is unchanged
avoid: AI-generated components; prefer human-made registry parts restyled to tokens
HUD chrome: brackets, crosshairs, scanlines, radar sweeps, glow
gradients, borders on content, shadows on groups
Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk or the system font as the brand font
tracked uppercase labels, eyebrow labels, middle-dot meta strings, arrows appended to buttons
cream paper with a serif and a clay accent; neon green on black
a spinner page, a fake $0, 'Soon', 'Quote only'
stock photographs of containers or handshakes; ShipXplorer or MarineTraffic tiles; frames from videos
any vessel, route, scene or number that was not recorded

decisions.decision: D-HOME-1: 'The strait becomes the book.' Hormuz photograph -> grid -> drain -> tracking -> the account's rows; Owner on paper, Agent at sea, one toggle. IBM Plex Sans / Mono.
Three treatments previewed before token values freeze: A photograph -> book (default), B chart -> book, C numbers -> book. Founder picks from screenshots; only token values change.

evidence.source: sampled from the Sentinel-2 scene's deep water and shallows
five-second test with five outsiders; Lighthouse mobile >= 85; axe; zero-hash test; contrast script; 21st review
